newsitem.title: CHINA: China's largest crude oil depot in operation.
newsitem.headline: China's largest crude oil depot in operation.

text.p: China's largest oil depot in Qingdao in the eastern province of Shandong, with storage capacity of 400,000 tonnes of crude, has been put into operation, the Xinhua news agency said on Monday.

The new depot in the Qingdao Economic and Technological Development Zone has three 100,000-tonne tanks and 10 10,000-tonne tanks, making it the largest oil depot in China, Xinhua said. It cost 500 million yuan ($60 million) to build.
The facility would have a storage and trans-shipping capacity of about one million tonnes of oil a year, Xinhua said. It gave no further details.
